name: Cytoshape — what is copied is the nonlegendary creature chosen first
notes: Found by tests/audit.py (2026-11-17). "Choose a nonlegendary creature on the battlefield. Target creature becomes a copy of that creature": the copy picker read "that creature" as any permanent, and the target picker offered lands. "that creature" is now read back to the "Choose a …" on the same line (cards-parser.js), and the subject is the target.
